description: This Java source file `UrlServletHelper.java` contains utility methods for handling URL-related operations within the OFBiz framework. It includes functions for setting request attributes, processing query parameters, handling path alias resolution, and sanitizing strings for URL usage. The class is part of the package `org.apache.ofbiz.common`, and interacts with various OFBiz components such as entity queries and web utilities.

classes.name: UrlServletHelper
classes.description: Final utility class providing static methods for URL handling, request attribute setup, path alias resolution, and string sanitization within the OFBiz framework.

methods.name: setRequestAttributes
methods.description: Sets request attributes such as delegator and servlet context, handling multi-tenant scenarios based on the request's server name.

methods.name: setViewQueryParameters
methods.description: Extracts pagination, sorting, and search parameters from the URL or request parameters and appends them to the URL builder, also setting them as request attributes.

methods.name: checkPathAlias
methods.description: Resolves URL path aliases to their target content or redirect URL, forwarding the request if a local alias is found or sending 404 if alias points to the current URI.

methods.name: invalidCharacter
methods.description: Sanitizes a string by replacing various special characters with hyphens to make them URL-friendly, trimming excess hyphens.
